command:
set -eu
echo "APP_START_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ)"
echo "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-unset}"
nvidia-smi -L
echo "VISIBLE_GPU_COUNT=$(nvidia-smi -L | wc -l)"
python -c 'import torch; print("TORCH_VERSION=" + str(torch.__version__)); print("TORCH_CUDA_AVAILABLE=" + str(torch.cuda.is_available()).lower()); assert torch.cuda.is_available(); x = torch.tensor([6.0], device="cuda") * 7; torch.cuda.synchronize(); print("CUDA_TENSOR_RESULT=" + str(int(x.item())))'
